title: Camera firmware versions MV 5.4 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Tue, 19 Sep 2023

New: Added firmware support for Advanced Presence Sensing 'Areas' on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)
Bug fixes: Resolved an issue where MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x) sends incomplete payload for MQTT raw_detections
Resolved an issue that can cause temporary video loss after the HDR setting is toggled.
General: Improved Video Recording Stability on MV52
Improved performance for RTSP streaming on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)
Improved Audio playback performance on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)

html:
Camera firmware versions MV 5.4 changelog

New

  • Added firmware support for Advanced Presence Sensing 'Areas' on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue where MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x) sends incomplete payload for MQTT raw_detections
  • Resolved an issue that can cause temporary video loss after the HDR setting is toggled.

General

  • Improved Video Recording Stability on MV52
  • Improved performance for RTSP streaming on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)
  • Improved Audio playback performance on MV12/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x)
